name: FlashData YouTube Creative Commons License Metadata
description: Inspect a YouTube video’s Creative Commons license classification. Record the returned license-label signal for a separate rights review. For AI agents using their own FlashData API key and paid Credits. Independent provider, not affiliated with Google or YouTube. Requires Node.js 22.18.0 or later. License metadata is a label signal, not permission to train models or reuse content.
author: FlashData
